page.overview:
What is Nori Nori no Mi?

The Nori Nori no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to control anything they ride, turning them into a . It was eaten by Bluegrass.

This fruit allows the user to control anything or anyone they take a ride on, mechanical or otherwise, regardless of the target's own will or anything else influencing them. This can even override the command hierarchy of the Pacifista. This ability can also affect targets within range of the user's Haki.

Due to the user having to physically ride on top of a target, the ability is seemingly limited to controlling a single target at once. Also, the user may be left vulnerable to attacks regardless of the power of the individual they ride. Apart from these, there are no known weaknesses for this fruit besides the usual Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Bluegrass uses this ability to control powerful individuals, such as a Pacifista Mark III, and a Sea Beast Weapon.
